programme.desc: Viaje a los escenarios de 'Tasio', la mítica película de Montxo Armendáriz rodada en Viloria.

programme.title: Amo la Cocina
programme.desc: Tras una charla con Gordon Ramsay, un chef londinense convierte un pub rural en un restaurante gourmet.

programme.title: Proscrito
programme.desc: Una historia llena de acción, corrupción y asesinatos. En inferioridad numérica, superado en armamento y contra todo pronóstico, un comando se abre paso a través de un asedio para salvar a su chica.

programme.title: La leyenda del príncipe
programme.desc: Una antigua leyenda nórdica sobre la venganza, el poder y el espíritu humano, que posteriormente inspiró a William Shakespeare en su tragedia Hamlet.

programme.title: Zebras
programme.desc: La mayoría de nosotros sabemos que, en 2014, Brasil celebró uno de los mayores eventos deportivos de la tierra: la Copa Mundial de la FIFA. Lo que menos gente sabe es que, pocos meses antes de eso, se celebró allí otra Copa del Mundo: La Copa Mundial de los Niños de la Calle.

programme.title: El silencio de Augusto
programme.desc: Tras descubrir la infidelidad de su esposa, Augusto, un profesor universitario, intenta quitarse la vida frente a ella y su amante. Sobrevive, pero queda en cuadriplejia, atrapado en el silencio absoluto. Un drama intenso sobre la traición, el dolor y la soledad de un hombre prisionero en su propio cuerpo.

programme.title: Intrusión alienígena
programme.desc: Despues de un aterrizaje forzoso en las afueras de una ciudad del desierto, un extraterrestre solicita la ayuda de una camarera local para recuperar a un monstruo que ha escapado de los restos de su nave espacial en esta parodia carinosa, conocedora e hilarante del pasado mas tonto de un genero.

programme.title: Great White Death
programme.desc: The most shocking, goriest shark attacks ever caught on film are right here - sometimes only the camera survives!

programme.title: Like A Bat Outta Hell
programme.desc: A young group of avid documentary film makers are sent to shoot in the vast extremes of the South Australian wilderness. They end up in a place called Nowhere Else. What transpires there is devastatingly, like nothing else on Earth.

programme.title: El monstruo humano AKA The Human Monster
programme.desc: Agente de seguros-medico cobra polizas de hombres asesinados por un residente desfigurado del hogar para ciegos donde actua como medico de guardia.

programme.title: Vampire Circus
programme.desc: As the plague sweeps the countryside, a quarantined village is visited by a mysterious traveling circus. Soon, young children begin to disappear, and the locals suspect the circus troupe might be hiding a horrifying secret.

programme.title: La venganza de los cheyennes
programme.desc: Cuando Charlotte Sutter es secuestrada por los apaches, su hermano Sam, ayudado por un viejo buscador borracho, va en su busca.

programme.title: Juan Moreira
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, el arriero Juan Moreira es un buen gaucho y trabajador que, como muchos otros, es objeto de abusos y humillaciones por parte de los poderosos: los terratenientes de la policía.

programme.title: Doc West
programme.desc: El legendario jugador de póquer Triggerman llega a un torneo donde las apuestas son altas y los bandidos juegan sucio. Pronto, las trampas y las balas vuelan, convirtiendo el juego en un duelo a vida o muerte. Con su habilidad y su revólver, Triggerman no dejará que nadie lo aparte de la victoria.

programme.title: Perseguido
programme.desc: Huérfano tras el asesinato de su familia, Jeb es criado en un rancho, pero su pasado lo persigue. Enamorado de su hermana adoptiva y enfrentado a su hermano, también es acechado por un misterioso tío que busca venganza. A pesar de convertirse en héroe de guerra, Jeb lucha contra enemigos ocultos y un destino trágico en el salvaje Oeste.

programme.title: Fragmento / Member
programme.desc: Haise decide luchar con todas sus fuerzas para proteger a sus hombres de Sierpe, pero este es demasiado fuerte y se ve obligado a usar el kagune y el quinque a la vez, lo que hace que corra el riesgo de perder el control de sí mismo.

programme.title: La víspera / Fresh
programme.desc: El escuadrón Quinx toma parte en una operación conjunta con el escuadrón de Suzuya para detener a la ghoul Nutcracker. Para llevar a cabo su misión se infiltran en una subasta de jóvenes humanas organizada por la ghoul Big Madam.

programme.title: Subasta / Main
programme.desc: Tras quedar aislada del exterior, Mutsuki acaba siendo comprada por Nutcracker en una subasta en la que los Payasos actúan como maestros de ceremonias. Fuera, la CCG rodea el complejo con órdenes de exterminar a todos los ghouls.

programme.title: Fin de la noche / Press
programme.desc: Sasaki y el escuadrón Quinx se enfrentan a Kanae con la intención de salvar a Mutsuki. Mientras tanto, los inspectores de la CCG son diezmados por Nutcracker y Takizawa, ahora un enloquecido ghoul de un solo ojo llamado Owl.

programme.title: Conclusión / Turn
programme.desc: Haise tiene visiones de su vida como Kaneki mientras continúa con su ofensiva contra Takizawa en el escenario principal. Al mismo tiempo, Shirazu trata de hacer que Saiko le ayude a someter a Nutcracker en el edificio administrativo.

programme.title: Recuerdos del pasado / Mind
programme.desc: Hinami es arrestada por los inspectores de la CCG y Haise le salva la vida al reclamar sus derechos de posesión. En las semanas posteriores, los miembros del escuadrón Quinx son ascendidos y Haise les invita a una cena de celebración.

programme.title: Como un gusano / Take
programme.desc: La CCG inicia la investigación de una banda organizada de ghouls conocida como los Rose que se dedica al secuestro en masa. Mientras tanto, el estado de Tsukiyama empeora porque al estar hambriento no puede controlar su kagune.

programme.title: Espectro / Play
programme.desc: Tras ver una foto de Haise, Tsukiyama corre a su encuentro para recordarle que es Kaneki. Haise lleva al escuadrón Quinx hasta la tienda de Uta para encargar máscaras con las que puedan hacerse pasar por ghouls en el caso Rose.

programme.title: Temblor / Think
programme.desc: Haise le pide a Ui que reconsidere su plan de llevar a cabo una misión encubierta y esta finalmente acepta. Esa misma noche, Haise viste la máscara de Kaneki y los ghouls lo reconocen como el ghoul del parche y comienzan a investigarlo.

programme.title: Incompleto / Write
programme.desc: Matsumae y Mairo tratan de detener a los investigadores de la CGG el tiempo suficiente para que Tsukiyama escape. Mientras Noro se interpone en el camino del escuadrón Quinx, Haise se enfrenta finalmente a Tsukiyama en el helipuerto.

programme.title: Amanecer / Beautiful Dream
programme.desc: Cuando el escuadrón Quinx se ve contra las cuerdas, Shirazu decide ir a por todas para detener a Noro. Mientras tanto, Kanae lanza un ataque furioso contra Haise, quien comienza a recuperar los recuerdos de su vida como Kaneki.

programme.title: Street Fighter II
programme.desc: En un futuro cercano, la organización terrorista Shadowland da un paso adelante en su conquista del mundo asesinando a políticos clave a nivel internacional. Su líder supremo Bison pretende encontrar y capturar a los mejores expertos en artes marciales para convertirlos en máquinas de matar. Con un ejército de guerreros invencibles a sus órdenes, los únicos que poseen el potencial para detenerle son dos legendarios expertos en artes marciales: el famoso campeón Ken Masters y su antiguo compañero de entrenamiento Ryu, que viaja por el mundo para poner a prueba sus habilidades contra todo tipo de luchadores. Pero el maquiavélico plan de Bison pasa por enfrentar a Ryu contra Ken en la lucha de las luchas con el destino del mundo en juego.

programme.title: Recogiendo capullos vacíos
programme.desc: Ginko decide ir a visitar a Aya, una chica experta en el uso de unos Mushis conocidos como "Uros", capaces de abrir fisuras en el mundo físico en el que vivimos. ¿Podrán ambos descubrir dónde se encuentra Ito, la hermana desaparecida de Aya?

programme.title: El ropaje que envuelve la montaña
programme.desc: Kai es un pintor que se vió obligado a abandonar su aldea para poder forjarse un futuro en su profesión. Debido al talento que posee, pronto alcanzará la fama, pero no así la felicidad que tanto ansía. Un kimono adornado con una de sus pinturas podría ser la clave de todo.

programme.title: Un hilo en el cielo
programme.desc: Seishirô y Fuki serían una pareja feliz si no fuese porque Fuki es considerada como una chica "rara" que inventa historias acerca de cuerdas que parecen colgar desde el cielo y su manía de desparecer sin previo aviso... ¿Tendrán los Mushis algo que ver con esto?

programme.title: Un mar de tinta
programme.desc: Tan´yû, la "Escriba", está maldita: el conocido como el "Mushi Prohibido" lleva invadiendo la sangre de su linaje desde tiempos muy remotos. La única forma de librarse de él se transcribir historias que narren derrotas de los Mushis a manos de los Mushi-shis.

programme.title: La espora de algodón
programme.desc: Durante su embarazo, Aki queda marcada por una extraña espora de color verduzco. Cuando dio a luz, su bebé no tenía forma humana, sino la de una sustancia gelatinosa y escurridiza. Y lo más intrigante: todo sus hijos son tan parecidos que parecen clones. ¿Resolverá Ginko este misterio?

programme.title: El templo del mar
programme.desc: Ginko llega a cuyos habitantes parecen "renacer" una y otra vez... Sólo deben cumplir una condición para ello: morir en una región del mar que reluce misteriosamente en la noche. ¿Es posible que exista un paraíso semejante en la Tierra?

programme.title: El llanto del óxido
programme.desc: Shige es una chica cuya voz hace que todo aquél que la oiga comience a experimentar un paulatino proceso de oxidación en su cuerpo. Ginko se prestará a ayudar a Shige y a liberar a sus vecinos de esta extraña enfermedad.

programme.title: Atado al campo en llamas
programme.desc: ¿Habéis oído hablar alguna vez de los "Fuegos Fatuos"? Pues bien, este inexplicable fenómeno está producido por la acción de unos Mushis que devoran el calor corporal de cuanto les rodean. Ginko se enfrentará a ellos.

programme.title: Ojo de la fortuna, ojo del infortunio
programme.desc: ¿No sería maravilloso poseer unos ojos que, además de devolver la vista a los invidentes, les permitiesen predecir el futuro? Amane disfrutó de este preciado don hasta que sus ojos comenzaron a mostrarle demasiadas cosas... Ella afirma que el destino no se puede cambiar. Ginko no lo tiene tan claro.

programme.title: El sonido de pisar la hierba
programme.desc: Taku es el orgulloso hijo del "Dueño" de la montaña, pero cuando conoce a Isaza y su forma de vida nómada, comienza a plantearse la vida de otra forma. Además, un extraño niño con el pelo blanco y un solo ojo entra a formar parte de la tribu.

programme.title: Digimon Adventure Last Evolution Kizuna
programme.desc: Han pasado 10 años desde que Tai y Agumon se conocieron y comenzaron su aventura en el mundo digital. Tai se ha convertido en universitario mientras que Matt y los otros han seguido sus propios caminos en la vida. Pero una serie de incidentes alrededor del mundo hace que los niños elegidos se reúnan de nuevo para combatir al causante: Eosmon. Durante la batalla, algo sale mal con las evoluciones de Agumon y los otros Digimon y sale a la luz una impactante verdad…

programme.title: ¡P-Chan es secuestrado!
programme.desc: “¡P-chan ha desaparecido!”. Después de que Akane se deje llevar por el pánico y lo busque por todas partes, ante ella aparece una hermosa chica llamada Azusa Shiratori con P-chan en los brazos. ¡Akane y Azusa deciden jugarse a P-chan en una competición de patinaje artístico!

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott regresa a casa, en Woodsboro. Desafortunadamente, la reaparición de Sidney comporta que también regrese "Ghostface", poniendo en peligro a Sidney, Gale, y Dewey, junto con Jill, sus amigos, y toda la ciudad.

programme.title: La casa de los espíritus
programme.desc: Basada en la novela de Isabel Allende, cuenta la historia de tres generaciones de la familia Trueba. Protagonizada por Meryl Streep, Jeremy Irons, Winona Ryder, Glenn Close y Antonio Banderas.

programme.title: Fabricated City
programme.desc: En la vida real Kwon Yoo está sin empleo, pero en el mundo virtual es un gamer de éxito. Un día se convierte en el principal sospechoso de un asesinato, y sus amigos gamers se ponen en contacto con él para ayudarle a intentar destapar la verdad del caso.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: En un pequeño pueblo francés, un panadero aficionado a la literatura se obsesiona con su vecina Gemma, cuya vida comienza a parecerse cada vez más a la famosa novela de Flaubert.

programme.title: El gran atraco armado
programme.desc: El agente Wen está asignado a trabajar encubierto para un traficante de armas militar del sudeste asiático para encontrar y destruir algunas municiones.

programme.title: Testigo Protegido
programme.desc: Madison resulta herida al ser testigo de un tiroteo que involucra a dos policías corruptos. Encerrada en el hospital donde se recupera, deberá sobrevivir mientras ambos policías intentan matarla. Por suerte, le es asignado un veterano inspector (Bruce Willis) que le ayudará a combatirlos.

programme.title: Infiltrado (Larceny)
programme.desc: En una cárcel de máxima seguridad en México se custodian una serie de documentos con valiosa información. La CIA contrata los servicios de un ladrón profesional experto en operativos de alto riesgo, para rescatar esos documentos y mantenerlos a salvo.

programme.title: Altitud
programme.desc: Una agente del FBI es castigada y enviada a un trabajo de administrativa en Washington DC después de desobedecer a sus mandos en una negociación con rehenes. En el avión que le lleva a Washington conoce a un apuesto hombre de negocios que le ofrece una recompensa si le ayuda a bajar del avión.

programme.title: Pompeya
programme.desc: Pompeya, año 79 d.C. Milo (Kit Harington, Jon Snow en 'Juego de Tronos'), un esclavo convertido en gladiador, ve cómo a su amor, la joven Cassia, la obligan a prometerse con Corvus, un corrupto senador. Cuando el Vesubio entra en erupción, Milo intentará salvarla... mientras todo se derrumba.

programme.title: Llamadas a espiar
programme.desc: A comienzos de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, con Reino Unido llegando a la desesperación, Churchill ordena a su nueva agencia de espionaje que reclute y entrene a mujeres espía.

programme.title: Mr. Jones
programme.desc: Narra la historia de Gareth Jones un investigador que ha tenido la oportunidad de entrevistar a Adolf Hitler y pretende encontrarse con Stalin. No obstante, para ello, viajará antes a Ucrania en 1933, lo más profundo de la Unión Soviética, para descubrir una conspiración internacional.

programme.title: Sin pruebas evidentes
programme.desc: Una detective investiga la desaparición de una joven colaboradora de un famoso escritor. Aunque hay testigos de la agresión, el cuerpo de la víctima no aparece, lo que permite dejar en libertad al presunto asesino. Ante su persistencia en incriminar al escritor, la detective es apartada del caso.

programme.title: Presunta inocencia
programme.desc: En esta secuela, el juez Rusty Sabich (Bill Pullman) una vez más se encuentra en medio de una investigación de asesinato cuando es acusado de matar a su esposa.

programme.title: MS1: Máxima seguridad
programme.desc: MS1 es una prisión experimental en el espacio, donde están encerrados los 500 criminales más peligrosos del planeta Tierra. La hija del presidente de los Estados Unidos encabeza una misión humanitaria que llega a bordo de la estación espacial, justo en el momento que empieza un peligroso motín.

programme.title: Puertas al Infierno
programme.desc: La localidad de Devil's Gate, en Dakota del Norte, hace honor a su nombre: en ella ocurren sucesos extraños, como la desaparición de Maria y de su hijo, investigada por una agente del FBI.

programme.title: Freaked. La disparatada parada de los monstruos
programme.desc: Ricky, contratado por una empresa para patrocinar un componente químico, descubre que la molécula es responsable de monstruosas deformidades. Comedia loca con súper reparto y estatus de culto.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: 70 años después de una guerra entre seres humanos y extraterrestres que casi acaba con la raza humana, un niño prodigio es enviado a una escuela militar espacial con el fin de prepararlo para una futura invasión. Ese niño se llama Ender y él no lo sabe, pero es el único que puede evitar la invasión.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los Saviors, ahora dirigidos por Simon, atacan Hilltop pese a que algunos de sus combatientes están dentro, presos. Maggie organiza la defensa del poblado, pero ¿podrán evitar una masacre como la que Simon perpetró contra el grupo de Jadis?

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Jadis planea una muerte horrenda para Negan. Mientras, Morgan va en busca de Henry y Rick sale de Hilltop para cazar a los que huyeron durante el asalto comandado por Simon. Finalmente, los dos se encuentran en territorio enemigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras los hombres de Negan continúan con su ofensiva, Aaron sigue buscando aliados nuevos, pese a que pueda costarle la vida. Daryl y Rosita se enfrentan a un viejo amigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las comunidades unen sus fuerzas en la última batalla contra los Salvadores. Negan ha conseguido entregar a Rick un mapa con instrucciones, para así tenderle una emboscada.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y su grupo hacen un viaje arriesgado a Washington, D. C. para buscar los artefactos que necesitarán para construir la civilización que él y Carl imaginaron.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las comunidades se unen para restaurar un puente que facilite la comunicación y el comercio, pero alguien resulta gravemente herido. Además, varios Saviors han desaparecido.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Una desaparición misteriosa pone en peligro los planes para el futuro de Rick y divide al grupo mientras construyen un puente.

programme.desc: La visión de Rick de un futuro civilizado se ve amenazada por un cúmulo de traiciones y agravios pasados que nunca fueron vengados ni perdonados.

programme.desc: Rick se ve obligado a enfrentar el pasado en su intento por proteger a las comunidades y el futuro que Carl y él concibieron.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de salvajes que lidera Alpha ataca Hilltop para recuperar a su hija. Mientras tanto, una misión en busca de suministros se convierte en una lucha entre la vida y la muerte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl, Connie, Henry y Lydia se ocultan en un edificio para tenderle una trampa a Beta. Mientras tanto, el Reino sufre la amenaza de un grupo de extorsionistas que patrulla las carreteras y exige dinero a cambio de transitar por ellas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Se descubre el espeluznante origen de las misteriosas cicatrices que Michonne y Daryl lucen en la espalda, el motivo por el cual la actitud de Michonne hacia los forasteros cambió tanto desde la desaparición de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Por primera vez en años, las cuatro comunidades se reúnen durante la feria que organiza el Reino. Alpha aprovecha la ocasión para infiltrarse de incógnito entre los visitantes de la feria.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Se desata una tormenta de nieve terrible que sorprende al grupo de Ezekiel viajando hacia Hilltop. Su única esperanza reside en cruzar la frontera que estableció Alpha y acortar el trayecto a través del territorio que tienen prohibido pisar.

programme.title: Open Windows
programme.desc: A jilted fan soon finds himself pulled into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse after he accepts the opportunity to spy on his favorite actress via his laptop.

programme.title: Cosmic Conspiracy
programme.desc: There is a conspiracy to rule the world, but the truth is far stranger than fiction. Reality isn't what it seems. With UFO sightings and Alien Abductions on the rise, now is the time to awaken, and realize the biggest conspiracy of them all.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to the timid town of Miles County where he targets a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween night.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: Encounter
programme.desc: A group of friends uncover an otherworldly object in a rural field, which they soon discover holds greater secrets than they could imagine.

programme.title: Alien Arrival
programme.desc: A tech is sprung from prison by a revolutionary leader who promises him an opportunity to save his father from a scheduled execution if he completes a data-stealing mission. But it goes awry, stranding him on a strange alien moon.

programme.title: Final Voyage
programme.desc: Two men on the run encounter an old abandoned spaceship in the desert. They escape their pursuers into space and set off in search of a new home.

programme.title: Titan
programme.desc: Titan, Saturn's largest moon, is the main stage of the Mission Cronos. Orpheus, one of the astronauts who has descended to its surface, is searching for organic life forms. This is his story.

programme.title: Exile
programme.desc: After an alien saves his life, a rebellious teenager tries to become a part of the strange society that killed his mother.

programme.title: Point B
programme.desc: Four friends and Graduate students in the physics department of their University discover their clean energy machine actually works as a crude, rudimentary teleportation device. Through experimentation, adjustments and some misuse-use of the device, it is quickly discovered that the machine holds many consequences.
Two men. Living on the exact opposite side of the world. When one sleeps, the other one is awake. But when they finally meet, a simple question arises: Who is the dream and who is the dreamer?

programme.title: 2036 Origin Unknown
programme.desc: After a deadly crash, mission controller Mackenzie Wilson assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I., to uncover a mysterious object under the surface of Mars that could change the future of Earth.

programme.title: Alien Reptilian Legacy
programme.desc: Researchers reveal the presence of a supreme interdimensional intelligence that has been manipulating mankind for centuries. Interviews with experiencers and alien abductees expose a sinister agenda behind the alien presence on Earth.

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: A man with the ability to enter people's memories takes on the case of a brilliant, troubled sixteen-year-old girl to determine whether she is a sociopath or a victim of trauma.

programme.title: Assimilate (aka Replicate)
programme.desc: Best friends Zach (Joel Courtney, THE KISSING BOOTH), Randy (Calum Worthy), and Kayla (Andi Matichak, HALLOWEEN) discover that their neighbors are being killed and replaced by perfect copies of their victims. Their only chance to survive is to covertly record the invasion in a desperate attempt to warn the world.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: Beethoven -- Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra and Chorus in a recorded performance of Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 at Barbican Hall in London.

programme.title: Chopin: Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Mozart's Violin Concerto No. Four in D major, K. 218 with Anne-Sophie Mutter and the Camerata Salzburg.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 & Elgar's Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival.

programme.title: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programme.desc: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Walton: Viola Concerto & Brahms: Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Brahms's Symphony No. Four; Antoine Tamestit continues his Artist Portrait.

programme.title: Bach: Goldberg Variations BWV 988
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's "Goldberg Variations BWV 988" at the Leipzig Bach Festival.

programme.title: Schubert - Symphony No. 9 in C major, D 944
Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in a programme consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók and Johannes Brahms; the programme opens with Bach's Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: A performance filled with unforgettable voices and expressiveness.

programme.title: The Berlin Philharmonic in Tokyo
programme.desc: Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák's Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber's Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich's Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn.

programme.title: Mahler, The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Leonard Bernstein was the first conductor to record all of Mahler's symphonies on disk and on video.

programme.title: La Rebelión de los Muertos Vivientes
programme.desc: Un misterioso virus ha matado a miles de millones de personas y convertido a muchas otras en zombis sedientos de sangre. Incapaz de detenerlo, el gobierno desarrolla un videojuego, "Dead Trigger", que refleja los aterradores sucesos que azotan al mundo.

programme.title: La Villana
programme.desc: Desde que era una niña pequeña, Sook-hee fue entrenada para convertirse en un asesina. Cuando la reclutan como agente encubierto, ella tiene una nueva oportunidad, Trabajar 10 años y ganar su libertad. Su nueva identidad es ser actriz de teatro. Para alguien que vivió una vida de asesinatos, llevar una vida normal no es fácil. Pero pronto descubriran los secretos de su pasado.

programme.title: La Espada Del Dragón
programme.desc: Tres años después de Dragon Inn, la posadera Jade ha desaparecido y una nueva posada ha surgido de las cenizas, atendida por merodeadores que se hacen pasar por ciudadanos respetuosos de la ley y que esperan desenterrar la legendaria ciudad perdida enterrada en el desierto.

programme.title: Conectado
programme.desc: Un cobrador de deudas recibe una llamada de una mujer que es secuestrada por una pandilla desconocida. Él piensa que es una broma, pero pronto se da cuenta de que no es una broma.

programme.title: Avalancha: Desastre en la Montaña
programme.desc: Basada en la historia real de los primeros escaladores chinos que alcanzaron la cima del Everest por la cara norte. Conocida como la cara más desafiante de la montaña, la peligrosa travesía los obliga a tomar decisiones de vida o muerte a cada paso.

programme.title: Mañana, cuando comience la guerra
programme.desc: Lo que se inicia como una aventura para adolescentes poco responsables (diversión, playa, hormonas revolucionadas), pronto adquiere un tinte apocalíptico en cuanto se desata una guerra contra Australia que nadie podría haber predicho. Así, los ocho adolescentes deberán escapar e intentar sobrevivir en un mundo que ya no se parece en nada a lo que era.

programme.title: Soldado De La Noche
programme.desc: Un grupo de cazadores de recompensas se ven obligados a pasar la noche en un motel del desierto mexicano. Allí se enfrentarán a una horda de violentos corredores fronterizos, y descubrirán que su protegida, una mujer china, es mucho más de lo que deja entrever.

programme.title: Nick Tschiller (Parte 2) - Generosidad
programme.desc: El clan Astan amenaza a Nick, quien arriesga todo para frenar una gran entrega de droga en Hamburgo.

programme.title: La verdadera historia de la banda de Kelly
programme.desc: Esta película nos muestra la juventud de Ned Kelly y observamos su vida hasta el final. Las motivaciones de Kelly se revelan y las tragedias que rodean a su pandilla se muestran de una manera intensa y poderosa, comenzando con el amor de una madre por su hijo.

programme.title: Lockhart: Liberando el Talisman
programme.desc: La vida normal de un hombre da un vuelco cuando hereda un antiguo artefacto de cristal y se convierte en "la clave" para liberar al mundo del dominio de la esclavitud energética y del Gobierno Mundial Único clandestino. Después de un intenso y peligroso trabajo de detective, Jon Lockhart descubre que la familia Lockhart ha estado ocultando el cristal, también conocido como "El Corazón", de los malvados Illuminati durante los últimos 1.000 años, desde la época de Robert the Bruce y las Cruzadas. El Corazón de Cristal contiene un código científico que puede generar suficiente energía limpia e ilimitada para alimentar al mundo entero. Ahora Jon debe encontrar una manera de proteger el secreto de su familia y el futuro suministro de energía manteniendo el Corazón de Cristal a salvo de la élite "Illuminati", que no se detendrá ante nada para encontrar el corazón y finalmente controlar el suministro de energía del mundo para siempre.

programme.title: El Último Sharknado: Ya Era Hora
programme.desc: Decidido a devolverle la vida a su familia, Gil envía a su padre Fin atrás en el tiempo para detener el inicio de los Sharknados. En el camino, lucha contra dinosaurios, caballeros, vaqueros y una versión robótica de su esposa. Esta vez, no se trata de cómo detener los Sharknados, sino de cuándo.

programme.title: Hitman - El Rey de Asesinos
programme.desc: Un exjefe de la mafia japonesa es sospechoso de ser víctima de un ataque y deja una recompensa para quien encuentre a su asesino. Entonces, un asesino a sueldo y un estafador deciden juntos buscar al enigmático "Rey de los Asesinos" y ganar el codiciado premio.

programme.title: El Último Vikingo

programme.desc: Un agente del servicio secreto británico se enfrenta a la tarea de perseguir y eliminar a un terrorista suicida nacido en Gran Bretaña y su célula terrorista.

programme.desc: El comando Karan Singh Dogra y la inspectora Bhavna Reddy compiten contra el tiempo para frustrar un ataque terrorista. Sin embargo, pronto se dan cuenta de que descifrar la conspiración del autor intelectual Buraq podría ser más difícil de lo que imaginaban.

programme.title: Los Ojos Del Dragón
programme.desc: En St. Jude, narcotraficantes y policías corruptos han destruido un barrio urbano. Pero el recién llegado Hong posee las habilidades de combate y la visión moral para salvar a este pueblo de sí mismo.

programme.title: El Último Héroe
programme.desc: De joven, Andrey Rodin formó parte de un programa secreto de entrenamiento de espías. Veinte años después, vive en paz hasta que su padre, un antiguo agente del gobierno que Andrey creía ya muerto, le pide ayuda, lo que le lleva a aceptar una misión que podría ser mortal.

programme.title: La Maldición De La Caja Calavera
programme.desc: Cuatro amigos se encuentran atrapados en una habitación junto a un asesino poseído por un demonio. Ahora tienen menos de una hora para resolver los puzzles necesarios para escapar del lugar con vida.

programme.title: La Tumba Del Diablo
programme.desc: Un equipo de mercenarios bajo las órdenes de Mack, un duro veterano de guerra, es contratado por una misteriosa agente de la CIA llamada Elissa para rescatar a un científico que está trabajando en un descubrimiento arqueológico en el desierto del oriente medio.

programme.title: Urge
programme.desc: Una escapada de fin de semana toma un giro peligroso cuando un misterioso propietario de un club nocturno le presenta a un grupo de amigos una nueva y peligrosa droga de diseño.

programme.title: El Lobo Solitario
programme.desc: Inspirado en el libro clásico "El agente secreto" de Joseph Conrad. En una Australia futurista, todos los aspectos de la vida cotidiana pueden ser espiados por el gobierno a través de cámaras, intercepciones telefónicas y sistemas de seguridad. En una oscura librería, un grupo de activistas medioambientales se reúne en secreto. La idealista Winnie y su novio Conrad pretenden atacar el G20, un grupo que reúne a los mayores líderes económicos del mundo, pero no saben que están siendo conducidos a una trampa.

programme.title: Presencias del más allá
programme.desc: Después de más de cien años de servicio, The Yankee Pedlar Inn cierra sus puertas para siempre. Los últimos empleados restantes, Claire y Luke, están decididos a descubrir pruebas de lo que muchos creen que es uno de los hoteles más embrujados de Nueva Inglaterra. A medida que se acercan los últimos días del Inn, huéspedes extraños se registran mientras el par de "cazadores de fantasmas" con salario mínimo comienzan a experimentar eventos extraños y alarmantes.

programme.title: Somnia: Antes de despertar
programme.desc: Jessie y Mark deciden adoptar a Cody, un niño a quien le aterroriza dormir. Inicialmente creen que el origen de dicha fobia está en el traumático pasado del chico. Pero pronto se dan cuenta de la verdad: los sueños de Cody se proyectan en la realidad, y muchas veces lo que se materializa son horribles y letales pesadillas.

programme.title: Secretos Malignos
programme.desc: Mientras vuelve a casa tras una cita obstétrica, Esther es brutalmente atacada y desfigurada por un asaltante encapuchado. Este terrible evento parece ser una bendición disfrazada cuando Esther encuentra consuelo en un grupo de apoyo. Su vida de tristeza y soledad se abre a la amistad, la empatía e incluso la aceptación. Sin embargo, la amistad y la empatía pueden ser muy peligrosas cuando involucran a las personas equivocadas.

programme.title: Te Seguiré en la Oscuridad
programme.desc: Una joven deprimida tras la muerte de sus padres se encierra en sí misma, pero un romance inesperado con un hombre llamado Adam la saca de su depresión. Después de que Adam desaparece misteriosamente en las profundidades de un edificio de apartamentos embrujado, ella promete buscarlo, incluso si eso significa cruzar al mundo de lo sobrenatural.

programme.title: El Atrapa Sueños
programme.desc: La película se centra en dos hermanas separadas que, junto con sus amigas, se atrincheran en un torbellino de violencia de 48 horas después de una experiencia traumática en un festival de música underground.

programme.title: La Maldición
programme.desc: Inspirado en el folclore de Europa del Este, una traición impensable lleva a que se coloque una maldición maléfica sobre el linaje de una familia. Décadas más tarde, una boda une a la próxima generación de familias separadas. Cuando uno de ellos, sin saberlo, despierta una fuerza oscura que comienza a eliminarlos uno por uno, Hana, la matriarca del linaje actual, debe descubrir quién está trabajando contra ellos antes de que la maldición sangrienta se apodere de ellos para siempre.

programme.title: Blood Creek
programme.desc: 1936. Los Wollners, una familia de inmigrantes alemanes viviendo en Maryland, reciben instrucciones del Tercer Reich para hacer de anfitriones del Profesor Richard Wirth. La familia se ve obligada a participar en un experimento esotérico relacionado con unas runas vikingas precolombinas. En 2007, dos hermanos van a Town Creek con la intención de desentrañar el misterio que envuelve a los Wollners

programme.title: Trebol Maldito
programme.desc: Un malvado duende que ha sido encarcelado en las raíces de un viejo roble, es accidentalmente liberado en el Día de San Patricio. Una vez libre, lleva a cabo su sangrienta venganza sobre los descendientes de las personas que originalmente lo encarcelaron.

programme.title: Proyecto Lazarus
programme.desc: Narra la historia de hombre que, en circustancias trágicas, pierde todo aquello por lo que había vivido hasta el momento. programme.desc: Un grupo de surfistas encuentra un antiguo tablero de juego de la Inquisición española llamado "Mamba". Al jugar, desatan una maldición mortal donde los perdedores mueren de formas macabras, convirtiendo su diversión en una lucha por sobrevivir.

programme.title: Trebol Maldito
programme.desc: Un malvado duende que ha sido encarcelado en las raíces de un viejo roble, es accidentalmente liberado en el Día de San Patricio. Una vez libre, lleva a cabo su sangrienta venganza sobre los descendientes de las personas que originalmente lo encarcelaron.

programme.title: Proyecto Lazarus
programme.desc: Narra la historia de hombre que, en circustancias trágicas, pierde todo aquello por lo que había vivido hasta el momento. Para poder recuperarlo deberá atravesar una misteriosa serie de pruebas de origen místico, pruebas que pondrán a prueba su fe, su cordura, y le harán explorar los espacios más recónditos de su alma.

programme.title: La Invocación 2
programme.desc: Han pasado cinco años desde los acontecimientos de Sadako 3D. Akane está embarazada de un niño con su novio Takenori. Sin embargo, Akane muere después de dar a luz a su hija. Cuando la hermana de Takenori, Fuko, se encarga de cuidar a la hija de Akane, el infame Digital maldito resurge. Durante su investigación, Fuko se entera de la leyenda de la hija de Sadako...

programme.title: La Maldición del Castillo Margam
programme.desc: Un equipo de parapsicólogos estadounidenses viaja a Gales para realizar un estudio del Castillo de Margam, uno de los edificios más embrujados del Reino Unido.

programme.desc: La lectura de un testamento da un giro inesperado cuando llega una caja misteriosa que tienta a los herederos con sus deseos más profundos y oscuros.

Pero cuando la hija de un amigo desaparece misteriosamente, Ryan cree que el fantasma de su hermano intenta ayudarles a encontrar a la chica.

programme.desc: El gángster estadounidense Erik Vásquez planea convertirse en el máximo jefe del hampa mexicana, pero se encuentra con que se está ganando la enemistad tanto de los poderosos cárteles como de sus propios aliados.

programme.title: El Forastero
programme.desc: La trama gira en torno al contratista militar británico Lex Walker, a quien le informan que su hija ha muerto. Al llegar a Los Ángeles y descubrir que el cuerpo no es el suyo, inicia una investigación.
